sources.title: SatlasPretrain
sources.snippet: Learn more about SatlasPretrain, a large-scale dataset for teaching computers to extract information from satellite images.

sources.title: allenai/satlas-pretrain · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: They have already been deployed to develop robust models for detecting solar farms, wind turbines, offshore platforms, and tree cover in Satlas, a platform for accessing global geospatial data generated by AI from satellite imagery. See here for details on how to use the models and the expected inputs. The model weights are released under ODC-BY.

sources.title: GitHub - allenai/satlaspretrain_models
sources.snippet: SatlasPretrain is a large-scale pre-training dataset for remote sensing image understanding. This work was published at ICCV 2023. Details and download links for the dataset can be found here.
